title: Captain Whiskers and the Great Yarn Adventure
author: Hamidreza Rostami
moral_lesson: Sometimes being part of something bigger is even better than being free.
short_description: A brave cat captain sails a boat made of yarn and follows a loose thread on his greatest adventure.
long_description: Captain Whiskers is not an ordinary cat. While other cats nap in sunbeams, he sails the high seas of Grandma's living room in the S.S. Purr-fect, a boat made entirely of yarn. But one day his anchor, a giant ball of yarn, begins to unravel, and the loose thread leads him across the floor, under the couch, up a chair leg and into a treasure chest of yarn. There he finds a small, sad, tangled ball of yarn that needs help. A warm story about curiosity, kindness, and discovering that being part of something bigger can be the best thing of all.
visual_style: High-quality 3D animated children's illustration (cinematic children's animation), warm cozy homemade world with soft yarn textures and glowing afternoon light, glossy toy-like rendering

main_characters.name: Captain Whiskers

main_characters.personality: Proud, curious, kind, brave, very sure of himself

main_characters.name: The Yarn
main_characters.description: A small tangled ball of soft teal-green yarn with two tiny dot eyes and a little mouth formed in the strands. Sad and worried at first, then happy and smooth.
